title: nonintrusive-side-probe-for-canary-validation-and-tenant-isolation
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Goal: Implement a non-intrusive side-probe (sidecar observer) that duplicates a carefully sampled subset of production inference requests to candidate canary model variants for validation, while enforcing per-tenant cost budgets, isolation, and PII-safe redaction. This is intended to support canary rollouts and A/B validations without affecting production latency or inflating billing for tenants.

Scope:
- Sidecar proxy component that attaches to gateway/edge pods and forwards a sampled copy of requests to the validation plane asynchronously.
- Sampling strategies: stratified per-tenant reservoir sampling (to avoid over-sampling noisy tenants), route-weighted sampling, and deterministic hashing for reproducibility.
- Isolation: tenant credit accounting, soft- and hard-quotas, and opt-out metadata for tenants flagged as sensitive.
- Cost controls: central budget controller service, per-cycle credit reconciliation, and real-time throttles that downgrade sampling when spend thresholds approach.
- Safety: automatic PII redaction rules (configurable), request fingerprinting to avoid replaying masked tokens to candidate models when prohibited, and telemetry to track data leakage risk.
- Metrics and failure modes: divergence signal (KL over token distributions, top-k token recall), latency delta (should be zero for production path), and shadow path observability (success rate, queue depth, cost burn).
- Auto-rollback hooks: validators produce regression signals; if the candidate breaches defined thresholds for quality or cost over a rolling window, mark canary as FAILED and trigger rollback pipeline.

Out of scope for this ticket: long-term chargeback billing UI and tenant-facing controls; those will be separate PM-led epics.
acceptance_criteria: Sidecar observer deployed to canary gateway group and duplicates sampled requests to validation cluster without increasing production request latency.
Sampling supports tenant-stratified reservoir and deterministic hashing; sampling rate configurable per-route and per-tenant.
Central budget controller enforces per-tenant soft/hard limits and can reduce sampling rates when budgets near exhaustion.
Redaction pipeline blocks PII-sensitive fields from being forwarded; security team approves redaction tests.
Validation metrics emitted to console dashboards: divergence score, per-tenant sample counts, cost burned, and queue latencies.
Auto-rollback alert fires when candidate model regression crosses configured thresholds for 30m rolling windows and triggers rollback runbook.
Integration test that replays 10k synthetic requests and verifies at-most N% additional token cost for sampled traffic per tenant under a configured sampling rate.
notes: Prototype results from ENG spike: reduced KV-cache interference by attaching a read-only cache view to the probe runner (see spike PR below).
We chose reservoir sampling per-tenant to handle heavy-tailed tenants and to ensure smaller tenants are still represented in canaries.
Trade-offs: synchronous duplication would preserve exact ordering but would add latency; we opted for asynchronous duplication with write-ahead buffering to keep production SLOs intact.
Security: security review requested due to potential PII exposure; redaction rules must be auditable and reversible for false-positives testing.
comments: 2025-02-16 Miguel Santos: Initial implementation of sidecar connector is up in staging. Hooked into existing request-metadata pipe. Observed zero tail-latency regression in 95th percentile. Need to add tenant quota checks.
2025-02-18 Priya Nair (Security): Reviewed redaction approach. Need explicit allowlist/denylist per customer and automated tests for common PII patterns. Blocking until tests added.
2025-02-19 Miguel Santos: Added reservoir sampler and deterministic hashing; tested on sample traffic from payments routes. Sampling rate knobs are now config-driven via feature flags.
2025-02-21 Elena Park (PM): Confirmed acceptance criteria for auto-rollback thresholds. Filed follow-up for runbook automation (PM-3421).
2025-02-22 Aisha Kumar: Hooked up cost telemetry to central budget controller. Added an emergency hard-quota that disables sampling when spending >95% of allocated window.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: deploy sidecar observer in staging and validate zero-latency impact. Phase 2: enable sampling and budget controller integration in canary ring. Phase 3: enable auto-rollback triggers and connect to release automation. Phase 4: gradual ramp by tenant (opt-in groups) then org-wide enabling.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: accidental PII leakage to candidate models. Mitigation: strict redaction, security-only smoke tests, and a kill-switch in the budget controller. Risk: runaway cost due to heavy tenants. Mitigation: per-tenant hard-quota and back-pressure signaling to the sidecar. Risk: metric noise leading to false rollbacks. Mitigation: smoothing windows and multi-signal checks before triggering rollback.
